int Ans[Max][Lg+3],tmp[Lg+3],tmp2[Lg+3],fac[Max],ifac[Max],N,n,mod=1e9+7;

    int ans=1;
    while(b){
	if(b&1) ans=1ll*ans*a %mod;
	a=1ll*a*a %mod;
	b>>=1;
    }
    return ans;

	a[i]=(a[i]+b[i])%mod;

	a[i]=(a[i]-b[i])%mod;

	}

    for(int i=0;i<Lg;i++){
	if(bit(n,i))
	    vec.PB(i);

	fac[i]=1ll*i*fac[i-1]%mod;
    ifac[Max-1]=Pow(fac[Max-1],mod-2);

	ifac[i]=1ll*(i+1)*ifac[i+1] %mod;
